newsitem.title: UK: UK Labour Party sees opinion poll lead slip.
newsitem.headline: UK Labour Party sees opinion poll lead slip.

text.p: Britain's main opposition Labour Party, with 10 days to go before the May 1 general election, has seen its opinion poll lead slip by three points over the weekend to 16 points over the ruling Conservatives.
A Gallup poll in Monday's Daily Telegraph gave Labour 48 percent support, with the Conservatives on 32 percent. The minority Liberal Democrats were on 13 percent.
The poll also suggested that a large majority of voters -- 72 percent -- would be prepared to pay higher taxes to achieve improved public services.
